installer_source.requirement: A legitimate Rhino 8 for Mac installer obtained through an authorized McNeel download flow must be supplied or made available to the job without committing installer bytes or access credentials to the public repository.

license_method.requirement: The user or license administrator must explicitly select and authorize a valid Rhino 8 licensing path. OLEANDER must not create accounts, accept terms, request evaluations, or expose keys on the user's behalf.

execution_plan_after_authority: install Rhino 8 for Mac into /Applications/Rhino 8.app using the authorized installer
verify Rhino and rhinocode versions without claiming CP2
establish the authorized license method and verify Rhino can start without interactive license failure
build OLEANDER SP02 runtime-neutral GHX from the pinned official McNeel fixture
set OLEANDER_SP02_REPORT_PATH to an isolated runtime-state output path
start Rhino with -nosplash and a controlled startup command or start StartScriptServer
execute the GHX with scriptable -GrasshopperPlayer and wait for completion
record Rhino and Grasshopper versions, GHX hash, report hash, commands, exit state, elapsed time and logs
promote CP2 only if the real runtime report satisfies the exact topology contract
leave CP4 OPEN because GrasshopperPlayer does not provide the required Parameter Viewer / Path Mapper GUI evidence

promotion_requires: supported Rhino 8 for Mac runtime actually started
authorized valid license path actually accepted by Rhino
GrasshopperPlayer actually executed the SP02 GHX
tree_report.json was written by the embedded Grasshopper Python 3 component
runtime report includes non-empty Rhino and Grasshopper versions
BASE / GRAFT / FLATTEN / TRANSPOSE_BY_ITEM exactly match the locked contract
run receipt preserves immutable evidence references

cp4.note: A GrasshopperPlayer solve cannot substitute for real Parameter Viewer and Path Mapper canvas evidence.

stop_conditions: installer requires an unapproved account or secret
license requires unapproved purchase or Core-Hour Billing
license validation cannot be performed legally on the ephemeral host
Rhino opens an unresolved interactive licensing gate
runtime platform differs from the preflighted x64 macOS contract
GrasshopperPlayer does not emit the runtime report
report topology differs from the exact SP02 contract
